title: Horse in Ruined Landscape
description: A brown horse with a white blaze stands in the foreground behind a weathered wooden fence, looking directly at the viewer. Behind it stretches a misty, overgrown landscape filled with ancient stone ruins and crumbling towers under a dramatic, fiery red and purple cloudy sky.
prompt: A majestic chestnut brown horse with a white blaze on its face stands behind an old wooden fence in the foreground, gazing at the viewer. Behind the horse are misty green fields dotted with ancient overgrown stone ruins and broken towers. The sky above is filled with dramatic swirling clouds in fiery red, orange, and deep purple tones, cinematic fantasy style, atmospheric lighting
